text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An encounter with a Racing Dress—it is 
something that can alter an Umamusume's 
destiny.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calling such encounters "Engagements," one 
designer crafts Racing Dresses inspired by 
wedding dresses.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
World-renowned designer, Beauty 
Anshinzawa. With Beauty's Racing Dresses 
on the line, the Umamusumes' fierce 
competition begins once again this year—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
A black dyed by nothing else... 
Curren-chan, it's so very "cute."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much♪ 
Your cuteness shines right through too, 
Fine-san!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren was really looking forward to this 
debut race. 
Because I can finally show everyone the 
universe's cutest Curren.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Well then, it's time for our match. 
Wearing this Racing Dress, there's no way 
I'd give anything less than my all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Display event title logo.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One month prior— 
Beauty Dream Cup Muse Audition 
Announcement Venue.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
With the Beauty Dream Cup being held in 
Japan again this year, please tell us 
about your enthusiasm, Beauty-san!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm so thrilled to meet new rough 
diamonds! I'll be unveiling the absolute 
beeest Racing Dress again this year~!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of the debut race for your new 
Racing Dress, the elaborately themed model 
auditions always become a hot topic each 
year.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
It wouldn't be fun if it were always the 
same, right? Those who bring the finest 
inspiration through new challenges are 
what I call my "Muses"♪

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
By the way, this year's rough diamond Muse 
candidates will be taking on a 'Team 
Riddle-Solving Audition'!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
The theme is simply, 'Those who seek 
Beauty must polish their intellect as 
well!' I look forward to the participation 
of undiscovered rough diamonds 
everywhere~♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Please, form a team with me! 
I just have to get my hands on Beauty 
Anshinzawa's Racing Dress!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Of course! We promised we'd become "Muses" 
together, didn't we? Let's definitely win 
this!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My, what wonderful excitement! 
It seems everyone is completely captivated 
by the auditions.

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
For Umamusume who run in races, 
the feelings they hold toward their 
racewear must truly be something special.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Indeed—though I wonder why? 
Everyone's enthusiasm is far greater than 
I ever imagined—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(That sheer seriousness... 
It feels like there's more to it than just 
wanting racewear...?)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Fine-san~! 
Do you have a moment to chat?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Good day, Curren-chan. 
Is this about the auditions, by any 
chance?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you're so sharp, Fine-san. 
That's right, I'm looking for team members 
for the audition!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
We can participate in teams of five. 
Would you be interested in joining the 
audition, Fine-san?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I am interested as a spectator, but... 
Um, may I ask you a question first?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Why are you participating in this 
audition, Curren-chan? 
Is it because you want racewear? Or are 
you interested in modeling?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren wants to participate because it's 
Beauty Anshinzawa's racewear, of course! 
Curren in that racewear is bound to be the 
"cutest" in the whole universe♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(She wants it because it's Beauty 
Anshinzawa's racewear...)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Say, Curren-chan. You're heading out to 
look for members now, right? 
Would you mind if I came along?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the invitation. I was 
determined to obtain 
Beauty-shi's racewear by all means, so 
this is most welcome.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I have heard that her racewear is 
top-class 
not only in design aesthetics, but also in 
functionality and durability.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In order to continue racing for years to 
come, I would like 
to join forces with everyone and tackle 
this audition with everything I have!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehh, do the audition with Rice...?  
B-But... Rice might just be a burden if 
I'm with you...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Why would you say that? Let's do the 
audition together! 
Beauty-san's racewear is all sparkly and 
super cute, you know!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Besides, Rice-chan, you've always looked 
up to the "Muse", haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah... When I was little,  
I watched the Beauty Dream Cup on TV 
once...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whenever the Muse ran in her racewear, 
everyone watching... had such a happy 
smile on their faces.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It was so wonderful... and I've watched it 
every year since... 
So, if it's okay for Rice to aim to be the 
"Muse" too...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Let's do it, Rice-chan! I want to run in 
the 
Beauty Dream Cup together with you!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
If we all run together, I know it's gonna 
be so, sooo much fun! 
So let's do it! Let's work together and 
aim for 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Y-Yeah, you're right! Um, Curren-san! 
Please take care of Rice and everyone!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm so glad Ikuno-san, Rice-san, 
and Urara-san 
all agreed to join♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Say, Curren-chan. I found it quite 
curious— 
how did you decide on whom to invite right 
from the start?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You weren't just asking anyone likely to 
join the audition; 
you were looking specifically for 
Ikuno-chan and the others, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... the reason is simple. 
It's because those three are just as 
"serious" about this as Curren is♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Serious"?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, "serious". For example, Ikuno-san was 
concerned about 
the racewear's performance, right? Saying 
it was to keep racing for years to come. 
In truth—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's not just racewear. On a daily basis, 
Ikuno-san is thoroughly particular 
about anything she uses in races, like 
horseshoes and running shoes.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Because to her, that connects to being 
"serious" about continuing to run.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And I've heard Rice-san talk about the 
Muse before. 
About how the Muse brings happiness to the 
spectators.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
She wasn't praising the glamorous outfits; 
she was rejoicing over the smiles around 
her. 
I could tell that her desire for 
everyone's happiness is the "real deal".

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And Urara-san's "seriousness" about 
wanting to run with everyone 
is pure and stronger than anyone else's.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
To take on the challenge for Beauty-san's 
universe-best "cute" racewear, 
don't you agree there couldn't be a more 
"serious" team than this?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(For someone as perceptive as her to seek 
this racewear with such "seriousness"...)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—Captain? I believe it is my duty to 
understand what people desire and strive 
to realize it. 
Therefore... may I?

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
The screening criterion for this audition 
is said to be "intellect". 
Since it is a "riddle-solving" challenge, 
the danger is low, so I believe there 
should be no issue with participating.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Curren-chan. I have a special favor to ask 
of you. 
Would you please allow me to join your 
team?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Jeez~~! Fine-san, you're so dense when it 
counts! 
Don't you remember who the very first 
person Curren invited was?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren wanted to enter the audition with 
you from the very beginning, Fine-san♪ 
So let's do our best together, okay?
